title: SG-1.1 Define the shared palette and 480x270 render constants
summary: One shared palette module (max 48 colours) and 480x270 render constants with tested whole-number zoom
description: Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts exports GAME_WIDTH=640 and GAME_HEIGHT=360 and computeZoom. No palette module exists. tailwind.config.ts only maps HSL CSS variables. Desired behavior: a single palette file lists at most 48 hex colours in named warm and cool ramps, exported as constants and as Tailwind colours; config.ts uses 480x270; computeZoom is unit tested for whole-number zoom across window sizes and DPR values. Expected result: later SG-1.2 and SG-1.3 art code and UI tokens can import one palette and one render size. Why: the pixel-art overhaul needs a single source of truth for colour and native resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the palette module, when its colours are counted, then there are at most 48 unique hex values grouped in named warm and cool ramps.
Given the palette module, when imported by Tailwind config, then each palette colour is available as a Tailwind colour.
Given config.ts, when read, then GAME_WIDTH is 480 and GAME_HEIGHT is 270 and buildGameConfig uses them.
Given several window sizes and DPR values, when computeZoom runs, then it returns a whole number of at least 1.
Given the existing test suite, when run for the touched files, then no test assumes 640x360.

out_of_scope: New rooms, story content, backend, audio, deployment, repo clean-up
preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard tests
pixelArt, roundPixels and FIT scale settings

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay.
One native scene resolution of 480x270, whole-number scaling, nearest-neighbour.
One shared palette of at most 48 colours, defined once.
Tests are unit tests with dependencies mocked.
definition_of_done: All requirements below delivered with passing unit tests
